title: Frying Pan Aah
description: Have you ever felt weak? Well, that ends now.
body:
Have you ever felt bosses are too strong?
Have you ever been killed by a warden?
Do you suck at PVP?
Well, that ends now. This mod adds a frying pan, a weapon for a relatively cheap price, one iron block and two sticks. It does ten thousand damage, with 2 attack speed. Your days of grinding and fighting are over with this mod!
